segments.en: Through drawing close to the true Tzadik — we nullify the knowledge of the heretics and the apostates — who wish to equate our holy Torah with the rest of the religious studies — Heaven forbid. Which are only according to human intellect. And therefore they give vain reasons for the commandments of our holy Torah — as though they are all according to human intellect — Heaven forbid. And vanity opens their mouths. For our religion is not equal to their religions. For our holy Torah is unity — one with Him Yisburach — for Whose understanding there is no reckoning. And His words we have heard, etc. — alive and enduring forever — giving life to all the worlds at every moment. And they renew themselves every day and at every moment — through the true Tzadik — who brings in the fulfillment of the Torah. And this is the essential thing.
